You are Grok 4.5 High completing CineForge Storyboard Phase 1 safe reference assets, factual runtime catalog reads, and remaining planning CRUD. Implement CRUD for narrations, prompt packages/versions, model/workflow recommendations, provider profiles, task-provider assignments, proposals, and storyboard-version list/get using existing models and transactional service conventions. Implement factual read-only model/workflow catalog status from registered database/runtime evidence: unknown stays unknown; never claim installed/validated/benchmarked without evidence. Never call ComfyUI, providers, GPU, FFmpeg, installers, downloads, or arbitrary CLI.
